factual_claims.claim: The financial year 2025 presented a challenging operating environment for AS Tallink Grupp, primarily driven by constrained consumer and business confidence in its core markets, particularly Finland, alongside heightened geopolitical tensions.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The year 2025 proved to be challenging. Tallink’s results were particularly affected by economic uncertainty in our largest market, Finland. The overall unfavourable environment in the region has constrained private consumer confidence and adversely affected cargo flows. ... The war in Ukraine, uncertainty around US economic policy and trade measures, tight monetary policy, persistently high inflation, and the prospect of economic recession continue to be key concerns in all of the Group’s core markets.

candidate_sentences.text: The financial year 2025 presented a challenging operating environment for AS Tallink Grupp, primarily driven by constrained consumer and business confidence in its core markets, particularly Finland, alongside heightened geopolitical tensions.

factual_claims.claim: Despite these headwinds, internal adjustments helped stabilize results.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Internal decisions enabled us to adapt flexibly to the operating environment. The sale of three vessels contributed to optimizing the cost base, several vessels were chartered out, and we have remained a reliable dividend stock for investors. We have consistently reduced our debt burden and continue to treat this as one of the priorities.

candidate_sentences.text: Despite these headwinds, internal adjustments helped stabilize results.

factual_claims.claim: The Estonia-Finland route generated the highest segment result despite a decline, while the Finland-Sweden and Estonia-Sweden segments saw reduced revenues and profits, with the latter posting an operating loss.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue from the Estonia-Finland route increased by EUR 1.7 million compared to the same period a year ago and amounted to EUR 314.5 million while the segment result decreased by EUR 10.9 million to EUR 70.4 million... The routes' revenue decreased by EUR 3.3 million to EUR 225.5 million and the segment result decreased by EUR 1.5 million to EUR 1.3 million... On Estonia-Sweden routes the number of carried passengers decreased by 12.5%. ... The segment result increased by EUR 1.4 million to a loss of EUR 1.2 million.

Sale of the cargo vessel Sailor... Repayment of long-term loans and interest expense in the amount of EUR 18.7 million (EUR 34.0 million in the fourth quarter 2024).

candidate_sentences.text: This quarterly recovery reflected lower depreciation charges, strategic asset sales, and reduced financing outflows.

factual_claims.claim: Operating adjustments included chartering out multiple vessels to optimize utilization and managing substantial maintenance periods.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: As at the end of the financial year, the Group operated 11 vessels including 2 shuttle vessels, 6 passenger vessels and 3 vessels that were chartered out... The number of vessels in lay-up decreased from four at the end of the first quarter of 2025 to zero by the end of the third quarter of 2025... Capital investments in 2025 totalled EUR 33.0 million, while planned maintenance and repair works of vessels totalled 73 days.

candidate_sentences.text: Operating adjustments included chartering out multiple vessels to optimize utilization and managing substantial maintenance periods.

factual_claims.claim: Regulatory and fiscal pressures remained prominent, as increased VAT and income tax rates in Estonia and Finland, combined with mandatory CO2 allowance purchases, compressed margins.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: In Estonia, the reduced VAT rate of accommodation services increased to 14% from 1 January 2025. Additionally, income tax for both individuals and business entities increased from 20% to 22% from 1 January 2025... In Finland, goods and services that were subject to a reduced VAT rate of 10% became subject to a higher reduced rate of 14% from 1 January 2025... From this year onwards, the Group is required to purchase CO₂ emission allowances in full.

candidate_sentences.text: Regulatory and fiscal pressures remained prominent, as increased VAT and income tax rates in Estonia and Finland, combined with mandatory CO2 allowance purchases, compressed margins.
